parts.part: A search bar that opens a search view

leaves.what: Read Search.tsx past its doc comment: the closed bar's rendering of the query, the order of onAction/onSubmit and the close, the Results list.
leaves.why: The doc comment does not say that the closed bar shows the controlled inputValue, nor that onOpenChange(false) fires after onAction/onSubmit.

leaves.what: On close, the controlled inputValue is put back to the submitted query from a ref (onOpenChange), so the bar does not show text that was typed and abandoned.
leaves.why: SearchView has one value for both the field's draft and what the closed bar displays; there is no separate 'submitted query' the bar shows.

leaves.what: A first row 'Search "<typed>"' is an ordinary SearchViewItem whose textValue is the typed text, so it passes the view's filter.
leaves.why: The view has no built-in 'run this query' row; without it, typing something no suggestion contains shows only the empty state though Enter still searches.

leaves.what: Sticky header holding the bar; layout is full-screen under 600px and docked above, chosen with matchMedia through React's useSyncExternalStore.
leaves.why: The kit leaves the choice of layout to the app and has no window-size helper.

parts.notes: Not seen in a browser (none allowed): behaviour is from the kit's source and the types, not from use. The clear button in the bar's trailing slot resets query and filters.

parts.part: Recent and suggested entries in sections

leaves.what: Removing a recent search is not in the search view: it is on the page under the bar, a GridList of ListItems each with a remove IconButton. In the view the Recent and Suggested sections only run a search.
leaves.why: SearchViewItem is a listbox option: its `trailing` can hold a glyph, not a button, so a recent entry cannot be removed where it is listed.

leaves.what: The landing page: two titled sections (recent list, popular chips).

parts.notes: Sections empty after filtering disappear by React Aria's collection filter (checked in node_modules, BaseCollection's SectionNode.filter), not by anything the kit's doc says. Recent is omitted when there are none. Unverified visually.

parts.part: Results with filters in a bottom sheet

leaves.what: The sheet's Reset / 'Show N results' row is a hand-written sticky footer inside the content (classNames.content 'pb-0', footer '-mx-6 sticky bottom-0' on surface-container-low with a hairline).
leaves.why: BottomSheet has a title and content and no actions/footer part that stays visible while the content scrolls.
Slider's root is capped at max-w-[300px], too narrow for a full-width sheet; nothing in its doc comment says so.

leaves.what: Active-filter chips (variant='input') remove on the chip's own press, with aria-label 'Remove filter: …'; onRemove is also passed so the X is drawn.
leaves.why: The input chip's remove affordance is a div with onClick: pointer only, no keyboard path, no name. Its X only appears when onRemove is given.

leaves.what: Result cards are not pressable; the one control on a card is a save toggle (IconButton isToggle).
leaves.why: Card is by design not actionable (no directly actionable card); a GridList of cards would have made them rows, but opening a listing is outside this screen so nothing was faked.

leaves.what: Title component='p' and Body component='h3' were type errors; second attempt: Title as 'div', and the listing title as a plain <h3> with text-body-medium font-body-medium.
leaves.why: Each type primitive accepts only some elements (Title: div/h1-h6/span; Body: div/p/span); the list is only in the types.

leaves.what: Read BottomSheet.tsx (content/header styles, modal structure), Slider.tsx (root styles, thumbLabels), Chip.tsx (InputChip's remove, ChipGroup's props), IconButton.tsx (toggle props), Card.tsx (root).
leaves.why: Slider and Chip's doc comments say little about props; needed the slots' paddings to place the footer.

leaves.what: Results grid (ul of Card component='li', 2/3/4 columns), card insides (placeholder image tile with a category icon on surface-container-highest, price, title, meta), filter row, status line, centred loader.
leaves.why: Expected composition; no images are available offline so the media is a placeholder tile.

parts.notes: Filters: sort, category, price range, condition, free delivery; edited as a draft, applied by the button, which counts live. Loading is a timer (800 ms for a search, 450 ms for filters). The sheet opens expanded. The input chip's X click and the chip's press both call the same idempotent removal; I could not check in a browser that a pointer press on the X does not look odd. Sticky footer position inside the sheet's scroller is unverified visually.

leaves.what: The media is a wrapper component that discards the className EmptyState gives and sets size-16 and on-surface-variant.
leaves.why: EmptyState forces its media to h-32…xl:h-64 in primary with no size prop; far too large for an icon on a phone.

leaves.what: Both actions are passed as one node in `action`, in a flex row with a gap.
leaves.why: EmptyState puts action and secondaryAction side by side with no gap and no wrap.
To learn how media is sized and how the two actions are laid out.

parts.notes: Shown for a query with no match (try 'typewriter') and for filters that exclude everything; the text and actions differ (Clear filters / Change search, which reopens the search view). The search view has its own short empty text too. Unverified visually.

general_leaves.what: Page shell: min-h-dvh surface, sticky header, centred main column.

friction: No block served this screen (pager, stepper, radio tile, carousel, site header). Search.tsx's doc comment is good, but three things had to be found in the source: the closed bar displays inputValue, close fires after onAction/onSubmit, and how sections behave under the filter. SearchViewItem cannot carry an action (remove a recent entry), which Material's search view shows; a documented pattern for it would help. BottomSheet needs a sticky actions part: filters in a sheet always end with Apply. Slider's 300px cap and EmptyState's huge media and gapless actions are surprises that only the source shows; Chip's input variant removes by pointer only. Slider, Chip variants and the type primitives' allowed `component` elements are not in doc comments. Nothing could be looked at: no browser was allowed, so every 'yes' above means built and type-checked, not seen.
